Talk about revolutionary, right? Ok... Here's the deal with Stellar. This means it's a new kind of payment system that's ISO 222 compliant and true to the spirit of Crypto. As a result, there are no massive slippage fees that you typically encounter with other decentralized exchanges. Let me break it down some more. XLM is the bomb because it locks in the exchange rate right when you transfer. Seriously, this is huge! They're like the glue that holds everything together and ensures everything goes off without a hitch. Also, there has been a very slight increase in XLM supply. There's been a lot of news about the return of the XLM in its long term expansion, but again there's a lot of controversy going on. Just recently, we saw the rise above the point when Zilom was the market share market, when remember is that while a solid 26 developers have been working on the network since last December, the daily social engagement only clocks in around 4.4M. So if XRP wins the lawsuit, fingers crossed, its price will increase, affecting XLM's market dominance. And if you're not familiar with the term, market dominance refers to a project's market cap compared to the overall global market cap. Before XRP's lawsuit hit in 2020, XLM's market dominance was around 0.8%. But when XRP's lawsuit drama went down, it affected both XRP's and XLM's performance, causing a drop in market dominance for XLM. And unfortunately, that meant XLM didn't do too hot in the last bull market, but if XRP wins the lawsuit, that could be good news for XLM. In about two years, we could look at XLM's market dominance somewhere between 1 to 3 percent or maybe even higher. That figure is expected to balloon to around $10 trillion in 2025, three times higher than the all-time high in 2022. But, if XLM's market dominance reaches 3%, that would make the market cap for XLM, but if ,XLM's market dominance reaches 3%, that would the make market cap a whopping $300 billion! If the market dominance is just 1%, you could see an expected token price of $ 2 but if market dominance reaches 3%, that could jump to $ 6 $ $ And remember, since not all the tokens will be circulated by 2025, the actual price could even be higher. Of course, all these projected price estimates will only happen if the global market cap increases and XRP's lawsuit goes well. But hey, if you want to be part of the million dollar club, some experts suggest having around ten thousand XLM! So, if we assume a $100 billion dollar market cap for XLM, the price per token would be $2. And if you got ten thousand XLM tokens today, that would be worth $20,000. That's a 21 times return on investment. However, these numbers won't become a millionaire overnight. If you want to make $1 million at a token price of $2, you'd have to have 500,000 XLMs, which translates to about $46,600. But if the value of XLM goes up 21 times, like we're talking about, that $46,600 could turn into a million dollars. Since most people cannot afford to invest in E500k XLM, it is important to calculate the number of XLM tokens needed based on the best possible outcome. In this case, the estimated number would be 166,600 XLM tokens, which amounts to just under $15,000 at today's price. However, if the market cap increases to $300 billion-the highest level- and the token price increases to $6, a $15,000 investment could turn into $1 million. This would be 67x return on investment. Well, that's everything you need to know, if Stellar's XLM should be part of your crypto portfolio. Do you think Stellar is worth investing in? Comment your thoughts below. Until the next video. Bye!
